optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Procurement Operations Specialist, Insurance Claims Platform

professionalSummary.text: Owns the supplier panel end-to-end, from tender through rate sign-off to performance review, with delegated authority for panel rates.
professionalSummary.witness: Prepared the tender file for the regional repair and inspection panel: supplier questionnaires, the scoring template and the comparison sheet that the procurement manager and the claims director used in the award meeting. Panel rates were negotiated by the procurement manager; my part was collating supplier proposals, checking them against the rate card and drafting the award letters for signature. Wrote the end-of-cycle note after each tender, listing suppliers still under probation, open contract clauses and the hand-over items for the contract administrator. Responsibilities included tender file preparation, performance-pack compilation, proposal collation and end-of-cycle documentation for the claims supplier panel over about three years.

skills.text: Coordinates panel changes with claims operations and legal and records own responsibility boundaries.
